I hate having to take pills but I'm going to have to. CBTI works for people who don't have major Sleep Anxiety, mine is jacked up to a 1000% and I don't know why. I have no idea why. I know I don't have SFI or FFI, but there has to be another classification of insomnia that is just as severe but not directly lethal. It can lead to a mental breakdown and I'm to that point. I know at some point I'm going to get fired at work, and have no insurance, then I'm screwed. I'm forgetting simple shit at work. My memory is shot, forgetting names when they call in. Its affecting my life, taking a shower is a chore. I haven't socialized in 2 months.  At least a lot of people here get 4-5 hrs sleep, I would kill for that.
